ACT VII OF 2012
SINDH IRRIGATION (AMENDMENT)
ACT, 2011
An Act to amend the Sindh Irrigation Act, 1879.
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV,
20th March, 2012]
No.PAS/Legis-B-08/2012,
dated 20-3-2012.---The Sindh Irrigation (Amendment) Bill, 2011 having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 29th February, 2012 and assented
to by the Acting Governor of Sindh on 16th March, 2012 is hereby published as
an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---Whereas it is expedient to amend the Sindh
Irrigation Act, 1879, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as
follows:---
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the Sindh Irrigation (Amendment)
Act, 2011.
(2) It shall come into force
at once.

Insertion of new section 62-C in Sindh Act No.VII of 1879

ACT VII OF 2012

ACT, 2011

[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV,
20th March, 2012]
No.PAS/Legis-B-08/2012,
dated 20-3-2012.---The Sindh Irrigation (Amendment)
Bill, 2011 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh
on 29th February, 2012 and assented to by the Acting Governor of Sindh on 16th March, 2012 is hereby published as an Act of
the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---Whereas it
is expedient to amend the Sindh Irrigation Act, 1879,
in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as
follows:---
2. Insertion of new section
62-C in Sindh Act No.VII of
1879.---In
the Sindh Irrigation Act,1879, after section 62-B,
the following new section shall be added:---
"62-C. (1)
Notwithstanding any grant or lease by any authority or any judgment or decree
of any court in favour of any person, the land of all
the natural or artificial depression courses meant for discharge of flood or
rain waters shall stand resumed to Government and shall be exclusively used for
such purpose.
(2) Any person in possession
of Government land mentioned in subsection (1), shall
vacate such land within seven days of the commencement of this Act.
(3) Whoever fails to vacate
the land as required under sub-
section (2), shall be punished with imprisonment which may extend to ten years
and shall also be liable to fine which may extend to rupees one million:
Provided
that the offence punishable under this subsection shall be non-bailable.
